comparison.objective: Water soil while moving a leaf aside and avoiding leaf wetting; candidate separates ceramic media from metal washers.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual occlusion management and controlled liquid pouring versus feed pouring followed by screen grasping, granular agitation, and bridge clearing.
comparison.success_condition: At least 90 ml reaches soil, at most 10 ml contacts leaves, jug and leaf restored versus ≥98% media recovered, every washer retained, no spill/loss, and screen reseated.
comparison.reason: Controlled pouring overlaps generically, but the plant task does not test aperture-selective many-body flow or retention of a second material class.
